description: PR implementing TICKET-101 (Manage Users) against the 01-greenfield baseline. Simulates an ADO PR fetch (no live PR exists). Deliberately introduced two traceability/convention violations (an untraced StatusPill instead of reusing Badge, and a hand-rolled error banner instead of Table's approved error/onRetry props) plus two organically-discovered gaps (unimplemented empty-state acceptance criterion, hardcoded colors reintroducing a contrast failure) to prove /pr-agent's engines and traceability check actually catch problems, then fixed them and reran to confirm the verdict flips from fail to pass and ticket-time blockers get reconciled against the real implementation.

behaviors: flags PR components with no baseline/extension/exception trail as blockers, not just style nits
runs all three engines and keeps overlapping findings from different engines distinct rather than silently merging them
applies confidence thresholds per engine and marks below-threshold findings low_confidence without blocking
reconciles ticket-time blockers against the actual implementation on PR review, not just new diff findings
resolves fixed findings via ticket resolve rather than deleting or silently forgetting them
records a developer override with reasons/by/at rather than silently dropping the blocker
ticket validate passes at end of run
verdict is fail while any blocker is open, pass once every blocker is fixed or overridden

user_simulation.notes: No live ADO PR exists; PR content and diff were authored directly in the fixture repo and reviewed in place.
